name: Émile Durkheim
shortBio: Principal architect of modern social science and academic sociology; established social facts as sui generis realities and investigated mechanical/organic solidarity and anomie.
centralQuestion: How do external, coercive social facts and collective moral conscience maintain societal integration in an individualistic modern world?

keyWorks.title: The Division of Labour in Society
keyWorks.description: Contrast between mechanical solidarity and modern organic division of labor.

keyWorks.title: The Rules of Sociological Method
keyWorks.description: Defines sociological methodology: treat social facts as things.

keyWorks.title: Suicide: A Study in Sociology
keyWorks.description: Pioneering statistical study showing social integration rates govern individual suicide.
